Miyako Happy Hour: How to Get the Most Out of Your Visit!

Miyako Happy Hour is a must-experience event for anyone who loves Japanese cuisine and great deals. Located in the heart of Houston, Miyako Japanese Restaurant offers a delightful array of sushi, drinks, and more during their renowned happy hour. Whether you’re a seasoned sushi lover or trying it for the first time, this guide will help you make the most of your visit to Miyako during their happy hour specials.

Introduction to Miyako Japanese Restaurant

Miyako is a beloved Japanese restaurant located in Houston, TX, known for its authentic Japanese cuisine and a vibrant atmosphere. As one of the top sushi spots in the city, Miyako Japanese Restaurant combines traditional Japanese elements with a modern twist, creating a unique dining experience that keeps locals and visitors coming back.

Key Features of Miyako

  • Cuisine: Traditional Japanese with modern influences
  • Specialty: Sushi, sashimi, and various Japanese dishes
  • Location: 6345 Westheimer Rd, Houston, TX
  • Contact: [Phone Number] for reservations and queries

Miyako Happy Hour: Overview

Miyako’s happy hour is an event that draws in sushi enthusiasts and newcomers alike. With fantastic deals on a wide range of items, it’s a perfect opportunity to explore the diverse menu without breaking the bank. Miyako offers happy hour specials every week, featuring a variety of sushi, rolls, and drinks that cater to every palate.

Why You Should Join the Happy Hour at Miyako

  • Great Value: Discounted prices on popular menu items.
  • Variety: A broad selection of sushi, sashimi, and drink specials.
  • Perfect Timing: Ideal for after-work gatherings, casual meet-ups, or a relaxed dining experience.

Happy Hour Menu Highlights

The Miyako Happy Hour Menu offers a mix of classic and innovative dishes that showcase the best of Japanese cuisine. Whether you’re craving fresh sashimi, crunchy tempura, or refreshing sake, there’s something for everyone.

What’s New on the Happy Hour Menu?

Miyako introduced new items to its happy hour selection, including special rolls and fusion dishes. The Updated September menu now includes:

  • Dragon Roll: A mix of crab, eel, and avocado topped with a special sauce.
  • Spicy Salmon Roll: A fiery twist on a classic roll, perfect for spice lovers.
  • Beef Tataki: Lightly seared beef with ponzu sauce.

Miyako’s Sushi Selection

Sushi is the star of the show at Miyako Japanese Restaurant. With fresh ingredients and skillful preparation, Miyako’s sushi not only tastes amazing but is also artfully presented. During happy hour, you can enjoy some of the best sushi Houston has to offer at a fraction of the regular price.

Recommended Sushi Rolls

Roll Description Price
Spicy Tuna Roll Tuna with spicy mayo and cucumber. $6.50
Dragon Roll Crab, eel, and avocado with eel sauce. $8.50
Philadelphia Roll Smoked salmon, cream cheese, cucumber. $6.00
Rainbow Roll A colorful assortment of fresh fish. $10.00
Volcano Roll Spicy crab, tempura bits, spicy mayo. $9.00

Sushi Recommendations for First-Timers

  • California Roll: A simple yet delicious roll for beginners.
  • Philadelphia Roll: A perfect mix of creamy and smoky flavors.
  • Rainbow Roll: Offers a variety of fish in one bite.

Miyako Drink Specials

No happy hour is complete without a great drink, and Miyako’s happy hour does not disappoint. From classic Japanese sake to creative cocktails, Miyako offers a wide range of drinks to complement your meal.

Drink Menu Highlights

Drink Description Price (Happy Hour)
Sake Traditional Japanese rice wine. $4.00
Plum Wine Sweet and fruity, served chilled. $5.00
Kirin Ichiban Beer Light Japanese beer. $3.50
Sapporo Beer Crisp, clean Japanese lager. $4.00
House Wine (Red/White) Choose from red or white house wine. $5.00

Recommended Drinks

  • Hot Sake: Perfect for warming up on a cool evening.
  • Kirin Beer: A refreshing choice that pairs well with sushi.
  • Plum Wine: Sweet and aromatic, a lovely way to end the meal.

Recommended Reviews and Community Feedback

Miyako has garnered a positive reputation among locals and tourists alike. The recommended reviews often highlight the quality of the food, the friendly service, and the relaxed yet vibrant atmosphere.

Customer Feedback

  • “Miyako’s happy hour is unbeatable! Great sushi at great prices.” – Yelp Review
  • “The drinks are fantastic, especially the hot sake. Perfect way to unwind.” – Google Review
  • “Amazing food and excellent service. The sushi rolls are fresh and delicious.” – TripAdvisor Review

The Vibe at Miyako

One of the standout features of Miyako is its welcoming and laid-back atmosphere. The restaurant’s décor blends traditional Japanese elements with modern touches, creating a cozy yet sophisticated setting perfect for any occasion.

What’s the Vibe Like?

  • Ambiance: Warm lighting, sleek design, and comfortable seating.
  • Music: Soft background music enhances the dining experience without overpowering conversation.
  • Service: Attentive and friendly staff ensure you feel right at home.

Ask the Community

If you’re curious about Miyako Happy Hour and what others have to say, don’t hesitate to check out community forums and review sites like Yelp or Google. These platforms offer a wealth of information from real customers who have experienced Miyako firsthand.

Popular Questions

  • What’s the best time to visit Miyako’s happy hour?
    • Most customers recommend arriving early to avoid the crowd, especially on Fridays.
  • Are there vegetarian options available?
    • Yes, Miyako offers a selection of vegetarian rolls and dishes.

Miyako Happy Hour Times and Schedule

Miyako’s happy hour times are designed to accommodate both early diners and those looking for a late afternoon snack. Here’s an overview of the current happy hour schedule:

Tuesday 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Wednesday 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Thursday 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Friday 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM

Updates

  • Miyako has extended happy hour hours on Fridays until 7:00 PM.
  • New menu additions are expected to roll out in the spring.

FAQs About Miyako Happy Hour

1. What is the best dish to try during Miyako happy hour?

  • The Spicy Tuna Roll and Tempura Roll are crowd favorites, offering a blend of flavors that highlight the best of Miyako’s offerings.

2. Does Miyako offer any non-alcoholic drinks during happy hour?

  • Yes, Miyako offers a variety of non-alcoholic beverages, including soft drinks, green tea, and special mocktails.

3. Can I make a reservation for happy hour?

  • Reservations are not required but recommended, especially for larger groups.

4. What’s new on the Miyako happy hour menu?

  • The latest updates include new sushi rolls and expanded drink specials, ensuring there’s always something fresh to try.

Miyako’s happy hour is more than just a meal—it’s an experience. Whether you’re there for the sushi, the drinks, or simply the atmosphere, you’re sure to leave satisfied. Make sure to check out Miyako’s updated menu and plan your visit today to take advantage of the best happy hour deals in Houston!
